sql_templates.description: Selects top VCP candidates from the last 3 months with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.template:
WITH top_candidates AS (
    SELECT 
        p.symbol,
        p.company_name,
        p.price,
        MAX(e.trade_date) AS last_trade_date,
        e.close
    FROM 
        scores.stage2_vcp_picks p
    JOIN 
        market.equity_eod e
    ON 
        p.symbol = e.symbol
    WHERE 
        p.snapshot_date >= date('now', '-3 months')
        AND p.enhanced_fund_score >= 70
        AND e.volume > 100000
    GROUP BY 
        p.symbol, p.company_name, p.price, e.close
    ORDER BY 
        p.vcp_score DESC
)
SELECT 
    *
FROM 
    top_candidates
LIMIT 50;

synthesis_guidance: Summarize only validated evidence, surface missing evidence, and keep research-only framing.
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 0250
validation_rules: Ensure results are ranked by VCP score.
Limit results to those with a strong enhanced fundamental score (>= 70).
